title: Château Lumière
tagline: A junior sorceress wins back a haunted château room by room, casting spells with right answers.
readinessNote: Plays end to end: two wings, six rooms, turn-based battles, five mini-games, a save in the browser. Room rules, rewards and creature stats are data (src/data.mjs) and the questions are a data bank (src/school/), but each room's 3D furniture is a function in src/castle.mjs and each hub's doors are placed by hand, so a new room means writing code there first.
buildYourOwn: New rooms and rewards, new creatures (recoloured variants are one line), and a different curriculum: other times tables, another subject, your own question banks.
controls: Tap or click to walk, drag to turn the camera; or arrow keys / WASD, Shift to sprint, Enter to use a door
